title: Work Management Systems Engineer
description:
Blackbaud is seeking an experienced **Azure DevOps, Atlassian Jira \& GitHub Administrator** with deep, practical expertise in administering, configuring, securing, and governing enterprise\-grade work management and source control platforms. This role plays a critical part in **maturing our engineering work management and software delivery ecosystem**, ensuring reliable, scalable, and secure usage of Azure DevOps (ADO), Jira, and GitHub across diverse technical and business teams. This role will help shape standards, drive operational excellence, and ensure data hygiene, access control, security, and governance practices that support engineering, product, and project delivery at scale. You’ll partner closely with cross\-functional groups to guide tooling strategy, optimize processes, and improve the day\-to\-day user experience across ADO, Jira, and GitHub.

**What** **You’ll** **Do:**


Platform Administration \& Governance

* Own the administration, configuration, and lifecycle management of **Azure DevOps**, **Atlassian Jira**, and **GitHub**, including enterprises, organizations, projects, repositories, teams, boards, workflows, permissions, integrations, and automations.
* Maintain alignment with established **A****zure DevOps** **governance practices** and data hygiene expectations, including support for work item hierarchy, backlog structures, and work tracking standards.
* Administer GitHub Enterprise and organization settings, user and team access, repository lifecycle, licensing, authentication and identity integrations, branch protections and rulesets, audit capabilities, GitHub Apps, webhooks, and GitHub Actions policies using least\-privilege and secure\-by\-default practices.
* Define and enforce usage standards, fields, templates, and workflows to ensure consistency and reliable reporting across teams.
  

Engineering \& Delivery Support

* Partner with product, engineering, and delivery leaders to optimize usage of work management tools in support of Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, and hybrid methodologies.
* Provide expert guidance on backlog management, user story structures, acceptance criteria alignment, and traceability from ideas to deployments.
* Ensure integrations between Azure DevOps, Jira, Git repos, pipelines, and adjacent systems remain secure, scalable, and well\-documented.
  

User Enablement \& Training

* Build and deliver training, onboarding materials, and documentation to improve team adoption and maturity of work management practices.
* Support new groups onboarding into ADO and Jira, leveraging best practices and governance guidance established by Azure DevOps Governance teams.
* Provide hands\-on troubleshooting assistance, coaching, and advisory support to users at all levels.
  

Automation, Reporting \& Optimization

* Develop dashboards, queries, filters, workflows, and automations to improve transparency and reduce manual work.
* Partner with engineering leadership to ensure high\-quality reporting across backlog health, forecasting, velocity, and delivery insights.
* Evaluate usage patterns across work management and source control platforms and propose enhancements, policy changes, or standardization opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, developer experience, security, and compliance.
* Leverage AI\-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality and actively experiment with emerging capabilities as they evolve.
 **What you'll bring:**

* 2\+ years administering **Azure DevOps**, **Atlassian Jira**, and **GitHub** in complex enterprise environments.
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and scaled Agile frameworks.
* Experience designing workflows, permission models, project structures, and field configurations.
* Experience administering enterprise identity and access controls for GitHub, including SAML single sign\-on, SCIM or equivalent user provisioning, team synchronization, role\-based access, token and application governance, audit logs, and least\-privilege permissions.
* Proficiency with ADO Boards, Repos, and Pipelines, plus GitHub organizations, repositories, teams, access models, pull requests, branch protections and rulesets, GitHub Actions, and integrations with Git\-based source control and CI/CD tooling.
* Ability to partner with engineering teams to ensure accurate work item hygiene, traceability, and progress reporting.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across permissions, workflows, automation, and integrations.
* Experience creating documentation, onboarding content, and user training programs.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and engage with users at all organizational levels.
* Able to work flexible hours as required by business priorities.
* Ability to deliver work which meets all minimum standards of quality, security, and operability.

title: Microsoft 365 & File Management Systems Engineer
description:
As a Systems Engineer, Staff B, you will work within the Messaging and Collaboration Engineering team, managing critical cloud platforms across Microsoft 365, SharePoint, enterprise file management systems including Thru Managed File Transfer and Nasuni cloud file services, along with Teams, Exchange and other messaging and collaboration platforms. You will help keep these platforms well\-governed, secure, reliable, supportable, and aligned to business, data governance, and operational requirements

**What you'll do:**
===================

* Administer and support Microsoft 365 services, including SharePoint, Teams, Exchange, and connected productivity and collaboration platforms.
* Administer and support Thru Managed File Transfer across regional environments, including sites, customer and internal transfer use cases, integrations, secure access, audit logging, and vendor\-supported operations.
* Design, build, maintain, and troubleshoot Thru Flows and automations, including integrations that move files between Thru folders, Nasuni shares, Salesforce, and other approved enterprise systems.
* Administer and support Nasuni cloud file services, including filers, volumes, shares, snapshots, access permissions, DNS CNAME dependencies, and platform updates.
* Troubleshoot file access, performance, latency, transfer, automation, and availability issues across Thru and Nasuni. and restore files and engage vendor support when required.
* Engineer new or changed file\-management capabilities, including new Nasuni filers, volumes and shares, new Thru use cases and integrations, and approved proofs of concept.
* Apply security, information protection, data classification, retention, audit, and compliance requirements across Microsoft 365 and all enterprise file\-management platforms.
* Provide platform\-related evidence for audit requests.
* Support various productivity, collaboration, messaging, and file\-management cloud platforms.
* Work within an Agile team to groom, document, plan, and deliver work.
* Contribute to technical solution design, architecture, automation, operational readiness, documentation, and service delivery.
* Identify practical opportunities to integrate approved AI\-assisted tools into daily platform administration, support processes, knowledge management, automation, and service delivery while following company governance and data protection requirements.
* Monitor, triage, and resolve operational issues; act as an escalation point for cloud and file\-management services; produce root cause analysis when appropriate.
* Partner with internal stakeholders, application teams, Information Security, vendors, and support teams to deliver reliable and governed solutions.

**What you'll bring:**
======================

* 3\+ years of professional systems engineering experience.
* Experience administering Microsoft 365 services such as SharePoint, Teams, or Exchange.
* Experience supporting enterprise file services, managed file transfer, network file shares, cloud storage, or comparable technologies.
* Experience with Windows PowerShell and a demonstrated ability to automate repeatable administrative or operational tasks.
* Knowledge of information protection, security, data governance, retention, audit, and compliance concepts in Microsoft 365 and enterprise file\-management platforms.
* Advanced problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills, including the ability to produce and deliver root cause analysis.
* Experience developing system architecture and contributing to architecture and engineering standards.
* Strong collaboration, documentation, and English communication skills for working with varied teams and stakeholders.
* Self\-starter capable of independently solving complex problems and coordinating vendor support when needed.
* Commitment to continuous learning and keeping current with Microsoft 365, collaboration, and file\-management technologies and best practices.
* Demonstrated ability or willingness to use approved AI\-assisted tools to improve productivity, documentation, troubleshooting, automation, and decision support.
* Able to work flexible hours as required by business priorities.
* Ability to deliver work that meets expectations for quality, security, reliability, and operability.
